title: FCC Takes Important Step Towards New Band Plan and Creation of Complement and Backup to GPS
summary: NextNav announced that the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) released a public notice seeking comment on its innovative spectrum solution in the Lower 900 MHz band (902-928 MHz band). On April 16, NextNav filed a rulemaking petition asking the FCC to open this proceeding to reconfigure the Lower 900 MHz band and adopt new rules to enable a terrestrial 3D PNT network to complement and back up the Global Positioning System (“GPS”). This rearrangement of the band would also free up 15 MHz of valuable low-band spectrum for 5G broadband while appropriately protecting incumbent operations.
